3|Two decisions shape every gbrain lookup, and this guide covers both:

10|   `gbrain query` (hybrid), or `gbrain get` (direct). This is the

19|
20|A search mode is a named preset for retrieval knobs. Operation-level options
21|can override it, so the bundle alone does not describe provider calls.
22|The bundles are frozen in `src/core/search/mode.ts` (`MODE_BUNDLES`).
